reviewScope: DS-22/23 source review of all callable public components and compound parts: DOM/ref targets, state ownership, runtime defaults and every tracked semantic axis. Review sources are recorded per component. This documents supported behavior and intentional limitations; it does not certify every browser, assistive technology, arbitrary DOM attribute combination or standalone hook implementation.

variant.meaning: A named visual recipe within a component family. The word alone does not imply status or identical values across families.
variant.migration: Keep established family-specific values when they express different concepts. Introduce a named replacement plus a deprecation path only when the same concept is represented inconsistently.

tone.meaning: Semantic communication such as information, success, warning, or danger. Decorative identity hues and categorical chart series are distinct concepts.
tone.migration: Do not rename decorative Avatar.variant or chart category colors to status tone. Check the component's allowed subset instead of adding every tone everywhere.

size.meaning: Family-relative geometry or density. Button height, Avatar diameter, text scale, and Empty composition are not one common pixel scale.
size.migration: Preserve intentional family scales and document their dimensions. Do not globally replace small/medium with one abbreviated enum or reinterpret layout choices as fixed heights.

width/height.meaning: Physical or constrained layout dimensions; literal numbers and named presets require the owning component's units and meaning.
width/height.migration: Do not collapse a dialog's width preset into the control size axis. Existing numeric layout APIs retain CSS pixel semantics where documented.

id/ids.meaning: An inherited DOM id identifies an element for labels, descriptions, and focus. Record keys or a displayed list of identifiers are data and must be described as such.
id/ids.migration: Do not replace domain identifiers with DOM ids or route DOM integration props to a hidden input when the visible trigger owns the accessible relationship.

action/actions.meaning: Usually rendered action content. A function-valued prop instead needs its explicit invocation and ownership contract; inspect the type before assuming either meaning.
action/actions.migration: Keep ReactNode/ReactElement slots composable. Do not turn a slot into an event callback under the same name; introduce a distinct handler API if needed.

empty.meaning: Content or configuration shown when data is absent. String fallback, ReactNode slot, and structured recovery state are different contracts.
empty.migration: Retain the smallest useful contract for each component. No blanket rename or widening to a function/ReactNode without checking rendering and accessibility.

icon.meaning: An icon constructor and a preconstructed element are distinct APIs. Before/after positions are explicit slots; a semantic icon may be provided by the component.
icon.migration: Preserve Banner's typed constructor override and Button's element slots. Any future unification needs a new adapter or deprecated compatibility path, with sizing and decorative accessibility preserved.

change-handlers.meaning: Native onChange receives a DOM event; domain controls may report a value; Radix adapters use onValueChange/onCheckedChange. Closing requests and async saves are separate operations.
change-handlers.migration: Do not rename every callback to onChange. Preserve payloads, optionality, controlled/uncontrolled ownership, and promise/rejection behavior when proposing replacements.

appearance.meaning: Family-specific presentation treatment, such as Badge fill emphasis or Spinner foreground treatment. Distinct from semantic tone; values need not match unrelated components.
appearance.migration: Preserve established family recipes and their interaction with tone/variant. A shared name is not grounds for merging different visual concepts.

value/defaultValue/checked/open.meaning: May be caller-controlled state, uncontrolled initialization, native form metadata or display-only data. Each component review identifies ownership and payload; presence of a value prop alone does not imply a controlled input.
value/defaultValue/checked/open.migration: Preserve controlled/uncontrolled boundaries and reset behavior. Do not repurpose displayed values or native event handlers as semantic state APIs.

Absent.domTarget: Fixed span containing an em dash; no prop forwarding.
Absent.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Absent.defaultBehavior: Always renders an em dash in subtlest text; typography inherits.

ActionBar.domTarget: Outer sticky div containing RecordHeader, h1 and buttons. No arbitrary DOM props or ref are accepted. id is displayed in the breadcrumb, not forwarded as an HTML id.
ActionBar.controlledBehavior: Caller owns state facts, controls and action outcomes; the bar only invokes action.onSelect. Blocked actions render native disabled buttons.
ActionBar.defaultBehavior: Omitted actions render no controls; empty states render no facts. The first state is a Badge and later states use Indicator; control overrides use nullish fallback. primary omitted is secondary; truthy blocked strings disable the action and display its reason. tabs selects bottom-padding/border layout. Legacy breadcrumb overrides crumbs/id through RecordHeader.

actions.meaning: Array of labeled action descriptors, unlike the ReactNode actions slots elsewhere. Each invokes onSelect; primary changes emphasis; a truthy blocked reason disables it.
actions.migration: Preserve descriptor payload and blocked reasons. The one-primary rule is caller guidance, not enforced; use a new API rather than silently treating actions as ReactNode.

id.meaning: Rendered record identifier, not an HTML id or label-target attribute.
id.migration: Keep domain identity as visible content; use underlying primitives when DOM attribute/ref integration is required.

Alert.domTarget: Native div for the callout root; native attributes, events, style, className and HTMLDivElement ref forwarded. Root title is the ReactNode shorthand rather than a native tooltip attribute.
Alert.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content, interactive controls, pending/dismissal state and any focus recovery. No child inspection or implicit workflow state.
Alert.defaultBehavior: warning tone. Default role is alert for danger and status otherwise; explicit role overrides. Optional shorthand title/action wraps supplied body in Description, retaining zero-valued content. Dot appears with shorthand title unless icon=null. No automatic naming or focus.

action.meaning: ReactNode shorthand rendered unchanged inside Alert.Action; no cloning, forced color/underline or automatic dismissal.
action.migration: Existing shorthand is supported. Use a matching tone text token and underline on links that need the previous tone-colored treatment; button variants and handlers now remain caller-owned.

defaultChecked.meaning: Inherited native defaultChecked, forwarded to a div; does not establish checked or alert state.
defaultChecked.migration: Keep interactive checked state on a caller-supplied control.

defaultValue.meaning: Inherited native defaultValue, forwarded to a div; does not establish input or alert state.
defaultValue.migration: Keep interactive value state on a caller-supplied control.

icon.meaning: Decorative ReactNode beside a shorthand title. Defaults to Dot; null removes it. Ignored without a shorthand title.
icon.migration: Optional additive customization. In compound usage, put an aria-hidden decorative mark directly in Alert.Title.

id.meaning: Native ID on this named div. No IDs or label associations are generated automatically.
id.migration: Use root aria-labelledby/aria-describedby to reference the explicit IDs of title/description parts when needed.

onChange.meaning: Inherited native change event forwarded to this div, including bubbling descendant changes; not an alert state callback.
onChange.migration: Keep control state in its own handler; Alert does not interpret change events.

onDurationChange.meaning: Inherited native media duration-change event; Alert adds no media behavior.
onDurationChange.migration: Preserve native event semantics; use caller state for alert lifecycle.

onRateChange.meaning: Inherited native media rate-change event; Alert adds no media behavior.
onRateChange.migration: Preserve native event semantics; use caller state for alert lifecycle.

onSelect.meaning: Inherited native text-selection event, not action activation or option selection.
onSelect.migration: Handle activation on the supplied button or link.

onVolumeChange.meaning: Inherited native media volume-change event; Alert adds no media behavior.
onVolumeChange.migration: Preserve native event semantics; use caller state for alert lifecycle.

tone.meaning: Semantic visual tone; warning is the default. Explicit role and aria-live choose announcement behavior independently of visual severity.
tone.migration: Existing default roles remain danger=alert and others=status. Prefer explicit role=note for static content and choose announcement urgency for dynamic messages.

AlertDialog.domTarget: Portaled Radix/Vaul content div with dialog semantics. No generic id/style/root-ref forwarding; returnFocusRef identifies an external focus destination, not the content ref.
AlertDialog.controlledBehavior: Caller-controlled open; onClose requests dismissal and caller must update open. Dialog/AlertDialog pending suppresses close requests; AlertDialog onConfirm does not automatically close and caller owns async outcome. Drawer drag also requests dismissal.
AlertDialog.defaultBehavior: Closed when open=false; no uncontrolled default. Focus restores explicit returnFocusRef, captured opener, then a surviving dialog/main/h1. Optional absent description/subtitle has no aria-describedby. Dialog defaults medium=520px and pending=false; AlertDialog primary tone, pending=false and localized labels; Drawer max-width 640px/max-height 85vh; Sheet end side/420px. Optional slots are omitted when falsy.

Avatar.domTarget: Base UI Avatar root span owns the accessible image name, data-slot/size/variant/shape and caller style; native span props and ref target it. It does not clip overflow, so a Badge sits on its corner; the photo and the fallback carry the radius. A loaded Image is decorative within it; the Fallback holds the circle otherwise.
Avatar.controlledBehavior: Base UI tracks the photo's loading status (idle, loading, loaded, error) from Image; a different src is attempted again. All identity, hue, shape and size inputs remain caller-owned; inside a Stack, size, variant and the decorative default come from the stack context unless given.
Avatar.defaultBehavior: size=small (24px), variant=neutral, shape=circle; in a Stack, the stack's size and variant. Non-decorative name labels the span as an img; decorative hides it; explicit role, aria-label and aria-hidden override. title defaults to name. Missing hue hashes name into six hues. Without children, src renders Avatar.Image and a Fallback of the initials; children replace that content. Empty initials use ?. xsmall uses one initial; other sizes use two. A loaded photo sits on the neutral paint; caller style overrides the computed gradient.

defaultChecked.meaning: Inherited native defaultChecked; it creates no checked or disclosure state on div, heading or button targets.
defaultChecked.migration: Use root defaultOpen or Accordion defaultValue for initial expansion.

defaultValue.meaning: Inherited native defaultValue; it does not initialize disclosure parts.
defaultValue.migration: Initialize selection on Accordion root or use defaultOpen on Collapsible root.

id.meaning: Native DOM ID on the named part; Radix supplies trigger/content association IDs when omitted. Item selection identity is separate.
id.migration: Keep DOM IDs separate from item values and preserve ARIA associations when overriding IDs.

onChange.meaning: Inherited native change event, possibly bubbled from a descendant; not a disclosure state callback.
onChange.migration: Use onValueChange or onOpenChange for expansion state.

onDurationChange.meaning: Inherited native media duration-change event; the component adds no media behavior.
onDurationChange.migration: Keep native event semantics; use disclosure callbacks for expansion.

onRateChange.meaning: Inherited native media rate-change event; the component adds no media behavior.
onRateChange.migration: Keep native event semantics; use disclosure callbacks for expansion.

onSelect.meaning: Inherited native text-selection event; it does not select or expand an item.
onSelect.migration: Use onValueChange or onOpenChange for expansion.

onVolumeChange.meaning: Inherited native media volume-change event; the component adds no media behavior.
onVolumeChange.migration: Keep native event semantics; use disclosure callbacks for expansion.

DataTable.Settings.domTarget: DropdownMenu trigger and portaled menu. children replaces the default labelled IconButton; no root/ref/native passthrough.
DataTable.Settings.controlledBehavior: Table metadata owns density and view. Menu requests density toggles via setDensity and reset via resetView(table). Radix owns menu open state.
DataTable.Settings.defaultBehavior: Default secondary small gear IconButton uses label or localized Table settings. Menu width=220px and align=end. Density defaults to default; density option exists only with setDensity and stays open when toggled. Reset label depends on a named view.

Alert.Action.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content, interactive controls, pending/dismissal state and any focus recovery. No child inspection or implicit workflow state.
Alert.Action.defaultBehavior: Wrapping flex div below preceding content; no absolute positioning, event interception or child style injection.
